ValidationRule.description: This is for Corporate Airfares and QBS contracts where General, Domestic Amendment and International Amendment fields can't be blank before generating Deal Sheet. Applicable only for 'AU'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR($RecordType.Name = 'CA - Signed by Customer',$RecordType.Name = 'QBS - Signed by Customer',$RecordType.Name = 'CA - Legal/Customer Pending',$RecordType.Name = 'QBS - Legal/Customer Pending'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c , 'Signed by Customer'), NOT(ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(Status__c) , 'Signed by Customer')),OR(ISBLANK(General__c), ISBLANK(Domestic_Amendment__c), ISBLANK(International_Amendment__c)), Opportunity__r.Owner.Country = 'AU',NOT(Opportunity__r.Owner.Country = "US"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: General, Domestic Amendments and International Amendments fields can't be Blank when the Contract Status is 'Signed by Customer'
